stem:
The table shows the number of bottles of different kinds of juice sold at a cafeteria on Monday.

Juice Sold

| Kind of Juice | Number of Bottles Sold |
|--------------|-----------------------|
| Apple        | 11                    |
| Cranberry    | 7                     |
| Orange       | 18                    |
| Pineapple    | 4                     |

If the cafeteria has 80 customers on Tuesday, which prediction for Tuesday is NOT supported by the data in the table?

options.label: F
options.text: The number of bottles of cranberry juice sold will be 6 more than the number of bottles of pineapple juice sold.

options.label: G
options.text: The number of bottles of apple juice sold will be 6 times the number of bottles of cranberry juice sold.

options.label: H
options.text: There will be a total of 50 bottles of orange and cranberry juice sold.

options.label: J
options.text: The difference between the number of bottles of apple juice sold and the number of bottles of pineapple juice sold will be 14.

visual_elements: Table titled 'Juice Sold' with two columns: Kind of Juice and Number of Bottles Sold. Rows: Apple 11, Cranberry 7, Orange 18, Pineapple 4.
